newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: SOCCER-STAUNTON WITHDRAWN FROM IRELAND SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STAUNTON WITHDRAWN FROM IRELAND SQUAD.

text.p: Defender Steve Staunton was withdrawn on Friday from the Ireland squad to face Iceland in a World Cup European group eight home qualifier on November 10.
Staunton's English premier league club Aston Villa withdrew the player, who has been out for the past two weeks with a hamstring injury.
Villa manager Brian Little said: "He tried to test out his hamstring but it is still tight and sore. A realistic target for him to try and be fit is the match with Leicester City on November 16."
